1. A method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix comprising: i) removing epidermis and dermis of allograft skin; ii) removing cells in the dermis to obtain an acellular dermal matrix; iii) mixing glycerol, and a basic solution selected from a buffer solution and an animal cell culture medium; iv) dissolving sucrose in the basic solution to a final concentration of 20 to 40% by weight to obtain a cryoprotectant; v) penetrating the cryoprotectant into the acellular dermal matrix; and vi) freezing the cryoprotectant-penetrated acellular dermal matrix in a controlled rate freezer. (Currently amended)

8. An autograft substitute comprising the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix which is prepared by the method according to any one of claims 1 to 7. (Original)
